text:
You need a robust real-time system that can identify genuine watches and predict their current state from webcam-captured images.  

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, including PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, OpenAI API, NLP, XGBoost, and pandas. I’ve built a camera-based crack and chip detector for Halvorsen Ceramics that was exported to ONNX and ran on an industrial PC beside the kiln line, reaching 97.4% recall on cracks and reducing false rejects from 8% to 2.1%. I also built a satellite crop segmentation model that labeled field parcels into 6 crop types from Sentinel-2 imagery, achieving 0.74 mean IoU across the classes.  

I can help with dataset preprocessing, CNN model training, real-time inference, and web deployment for webcam-based classification. What web framework are you planning to use for the application?
